title: Implement the PR #143 handoff slice: route cortex graph/linear_program payloads to organs recruiting founder-attached formed functions, engines never trusted, certificates on every answer

roles.founder_intent_steward: The directive's executable target is the Competency Compiler: recognize a problem, determine which epistemic methods can answer it, recruit the smallest competent mechanism, produce typed evidence, respect authority, observe outcomes, improve future selection. PR #143 built Capability Genesis (qualify an installed package behind a frozen oracle, issue a Mechanism Card, founder attaches it); its stated handoff is this slice: the cortex must actually recruit those formed functions. The meniscus translation controls the design: the strongest defensible operating frontier is certificates over engine trust and truthful deficits over fabricated claims — proximity to an uncertain boundary is not a performance objective, so competence envelopes deficit-out rather than stretch. Building != installation != activation: the organs serve only what the founder attached.
roles.systems_architect: Layering is preserved: cortex/organs/{formed,graphsearch,continuous}.py never import greg; the bridge (body side) serializes Mechanism Card fields plus the qualified runner source into the worker request; the worker rebuilds the qualified execution path, re-pins the package digest and runner hash before every call, and runs the engine in a nested no-network interpreter. Cortex contracts advance 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0 with payload keys graph/linear_program, routing policy cortex-route-policy/0.3.0, catalog and MATRIX versions coupled, examples regenerated, seed freeze freeze-v0.3.0.json created. The reserved-family supersession pattern (cpsat precedent) is followed: the register rows that named cortex.graph.search reserved now read implemented, with evidence.
roles.adversarial_reviewer: Strongest attacks, each with an executable control: (1) a lying engine serves a false shortest path — the certificate (feasible potentials realised by predecessor chains, exact arithmetic, no shared code) rejects it and the organ returns INCONCLUSIVE with the claim withheld; covered end-to-end through the real network-isolated worker by monkeypatching the runner before manifest qualification. (2) The package changes after qualification — digest re-pin fails closed to DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. (3) The runner source drifts between qualification and serving — the runner's sha256 is pinned in the card and the serialized source is re-hashed in the worker. (4) A detached function keeps serving — founder DETACH resolves to a truthful deficit at both the organ registry and the function registry. (5) The slice could overclaim genesis autonomy — attach remains founder-only; receipts carry authority_created false. Residual honesty note: the crossgeo evaluation's FROZEN_CODE now lists the new organ files while freeze-crossgeo-v0.3.json's results bind the old code hash; re-freezing in place would silently rewrite the baseline, so v0.4 (a fresh heldout sample spend) is left founder-gated and flagged in the PR.
roles.operator_maintainer: Operational surface: two new enabled seed organs that resolve to DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (a truthful genesis trigger) until the founder attaches formed functions — zero behavior change on unattached deployments beyond new payload keys. CPU is bounded (max 20s per formed call mapped from the route budget); the 64 KiB request bound keeps every certified answer inside the 512 KiB receipt bound, no truncation path. Rollback is closing the draft PR unmerged, reverting the merge commit if merged, or founder DETACH of the formed functions (instant, converts the routes to truthful deficits). The runner_source serialization fix was forced by a real test failure (lie did not cross the process boundary); that failure is preserved below, not edited away.
roles.evidence_welfare_guardian: No external effects, no participants, no data subjects; read-only computation. Evidence tiers marked per item; the strongest tier here is unit_test/sandbox_execution (network-isolated worker subprocesses), never promoted. Negative evidence preserved: the initial lying-engine e2e returned OK (the monkeypatched lie lived only in the test process while the worker re-imported the honest catalog), which forced carrying the qualified runner source with the card; the first full-suite run failed test_reserved_claims_name_registered_disabled_families because the verbatim register still called the seeded families reserved; the baseline environment failures (sympy absent, tarball worktree without .git) were recovered before any slice test ran. Nothing was deleted.

passes.summary: Intended outcome independent of mechanism: a graph or continuous-LP question in cortex dialect is answered only with a GREG certificate, and every failure mode (missing, detached, drifted, lying, out-of-envelope) becomes a truthful typed state that feeds Capability Genesis rather than a fabricated answer. Advantages compound: each formed function becomes recruitable by the one entry without new cortex code. Reversal condition: if the card serialization became a channel for untrusted code into the worker, the slice reverses into a liability; controls are hash pins, the no-network worker, and the certificate.

disadvantages.handling: resolved by design: GREG-owned certificates (exact arithmetic, no shared code) gate every answer; lying-engine e2e through the real worker expects INCONCLUSIVE with the claim withheld

disadvantages.text: Package or runner drift after qualification could silently change behavior
disadvantages.handling: fail-closed re-pin: package digest and runner sha256 are re-verified before every call; mismatch is DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (re-qualification trigger), never a served answer

disadvantages.handling: made observable: no in-place re-freeze; v0.4 (fresh heldout sample spend) is founder-gated and flagged in the PR

passes.summary: Re-attacked as deployed. Bureaucracy: no new ceremony — one verifier version, two records, one draft PR. Centralization: routing centralizes recruitment, not authority; attach stays with the founder. Fragility: version couplings (contracts 0.3.0, policy 0.3.0, catalog, MATRIX, examples, freeze) are machine-checked by the traceability suite (159 passed). Gaming: an engine cannot game the certificate because it shares no code and uses exact arithmetic; a compromised runner qualified by mistake is still caught at serve time by the certificate, and drift by the hash pin. Dependence on one model: every claim cites an executable test or verifier check runnable by any contributor.

passes.residual_risk: Competence envelopes (size caps, non-negative weights for shortest paths, 20s CPU ceiling) mean large real instances deficit-out rather than solve; that is the intended frontier behavior, and each deficit is a genesis trigger with its reason.

dissent.strongest_objection: Certificates make answers trustworthy, but the formed functions themselves were qualified against a frozen oracle of small cases; a mechanism that is correct on the oracle and wrong on a class the oracle missed will still be caught only if the certificate covers that class. For LP the duality certificate is complete; for shortest paths the potentials certificate is complete; for max flow the cut certificate is complete — completeness rests on the mathematics, not the oracle. Residual exposure is normalize() accepting an encoding of a different problem than the user asked (requirement_encoding is labeled 'request is the requirement; no separate encoding' — the organ cannot detect a mis-encoded payload).
dissent.resolution_threshold: Any served answer shown to diverge from the asker's intent while certificates pass triggers review of the payload schemas and the cortex-dialect documentation, not of the engines.
dissent.review_trigger: first certificate-passing answer that is wrong about the world (mis-encoded requirement), or founder request
